Why Is This Ancient Egyptian Woman Holding a Mysterious Object to Her Lips?

A strange detail in this ancient Egyptian wall carving has caught everyone's attention. A seated woman appears to be bringing an unusual round object toward her mouth. What was its purpose, and why was it depicted this way? 

Could it represent something from everyday Egyptian life, or was it connected to a deeper cultural tradition? 

This mysterious carving offers another fascinating glimpse into the world of ancient Egypt, leaving us with more questions than answers.

Why does economic inequality exist? Why do a small section of society control a disproportionate share of wealth while millions of workers struggle?

In this lecture, Pranay Aggarwal Sir explains Karl Marx’s theory of economic inequality and how it helps us understand modern capitalist society.

We explore:

● Karl Marx’s perspective on economic inequality
● Means of Production and ownership of capital
● Bourgeoisie vs Proletariat
● Exploitation of the working class
● Economic Base and Superstructure
● Religion and other social institutions in Marxist analysis
● Class Consciousness and Class Struggle
● Marxism’s relevance in understanding inequality today
● Limitations of Marxist theory in explaining caste inequality

A useful discussion for Sociology Optional aspirants and anyone interested in understanding class, capitalism and inequality.
